items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: Yes. Well, Rickard was his best player.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I forgot. They started out there with Rickard Alexis for a while, didn't they?
Yes. Well, Rickard was his best player.
But didn't he have two bands? That's what I'm trying to find out. Didn't Papa have one band for the parties and one for the paddock for a while? Something like that? I don't know.
